title: 第341章 融化冰雪的力量第342章 一百万卡恩
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “寒翼妖灵，用风暴雪冻结他。”
艾莎指尖一翻，一张技能卡毫不犹豫地催动。
寒翼妖灵发出一声尖锐嘶鸣，振翅高飞，瞬间与扑来的阿肯瑟姆拉开距离。
巨大的冰晶双翼开始快速挥舞，一道道凛冽的冰系元力裹挟着刺骨寒风，化作漫天冰屑飞雪，开始笼罩整个战场。
“想用魔法攻击对付我？”
阿特拉斯之盾里，林奇清晰地感知到外面的温度在急速骤降，盾牌表面已经凝结出一层薄薄的冰霜。
可他脸上并未露出慌乱。
阿特拉斯之盾的防御能力极强，足以完美抵御这种范围性的冰系魔法。
可骸骨之王和阿肯瑟姆却在这急速到来的暴风雪中，身形都快被掩埋了，盔甲内的骷髅仿佛都要被冰雪给填满了。
填满？
“不对！”
林奇面色骤变，瞬间看穿了艾莎的险恶意图。
“她不是要限制，而是想从内部冻住阿肯瑟姆和骸骨之王。”
骸骨之王和阿肯瑟姆都是骷髅形态，全身布满镂空的骨骼缝隙，一旦冰雪彻底填满这些缝隙，它们的关节会被冻僵，魂火也会被压制，最终彻底丧失行动能力。
“骸骨之王，燃烧这些雪。”
林奇厉声下令，不敢有丝毫耽搁。
骸骨之王僵硬地抬起骨手，眼窝中魂火骤然暴涨。
下一秒，魔龙之焰从它的魂火中蔓延而出，顺着骨骼的缝隙流淌，瞬间包裹住整个身躯。
“刺啦。”
盔甲内的冰雪遇到魔龙之焰，瞬间化作白色蒸汽，滋滋作响地快速消融。
紧接着，
骸骨之王挥动终末大剑，将魔龙之焰引到阿肯瑟姆身上，黑色的火焰如同活物般缠绕在阿肯瑟姆的骨骼上，一同驱逐着它身上的冰雪。
“这个火焰…”
艾莎神色一变，眼中闪过一丝难以置信。
她催动的冰雪并非普通的冰系源力，而是蕴含着凛冬王国魔法的冰寒之力，寻常火焰根本无法消融，唯有史诗级别的火焰才能与之抗衡。
“真是看不出来，你的手段还真不少。”
艾莎的语气冷了几分，眼底的忌惮又深了一层。
“既然如此…”
艾莎又掏出一张卡牌，沉声低喝：“魔法卡，暴风雪。”
随着卡牌光芒暴涨，一场比先前更加狂暴、更加急速的风雪瞬间席卷而来。
content_en:
"Cold Wing Demon Spirit, freeze him with snowstorm."
Aisha flipped her fingertips and activated a skill card without hesitation.
The cold-winged demon spirit let out a sharp neigh, flapped its wings and flew high, instantly distanced itself from the attacking Arkensome.
The huge ice crystal wings began to flap rapidly, and the biting ice elemental power was wrapped in the biting cold wind, turning into ice shavings and flying snow all over the sky, and began to cover the entire battlefield.
"Want to use magic attacks against me?"
In the Atlas Shield, Lynch clearly felt that the temperature outside was dropping rapidly, and a thin layer of frost had condensed on the surface of the shield.
But there was no panic on his face.
The Atlas Shield's defensive capabilities are extremely strong, enough to perfectly resist this range of ice magic.
But the King of Bones and Akentham were almost buried in the rapidly approaching blizzard, and the skeletons in their armor seemed to be filled with ice and snow.
Fill it up?
"No!"
Lin Qi's expression suddenly changed, and he instantly saw through Aisha's sinister intention.
"She's not trying to restrict, but to freeze Arkentham and the Lord of Bones from the inside."
Both the King of Bones and Arkensome are in the form of skeletons, with hollow bone gaps all over their bodies. Once ice and snow completely fill these gaps, their joints will be frozen, their soul fire will be suppressed, and they will eventually lose their ability to move completely.
"King of Bones, burn this snow."
Lin Qi ordered sternly, not daring to delay at all.
"Huh~"
The King of Skeletons stiffly raised his skeletal hand, and the soul fire in his eye sockets suddenly surged.
The next second, the dragon's flames spread out from its soul fire, flowed along the gaps in its bones, and instantly enveloped the entire body.
"Stab it."
When the ice and snow inside the armor encountered the dragon's flames, it instantly turned into white steam and melted quickly with a sizzling sound.
Immediately afterwards,
The King of Bones swung the final sword and directed the flames of the dragon to Akentham. The black flames wrapped around Akentham's bones like a living creature, driving away the ice and snow on its body.
"This flame..."
Aisha's expression changed, and a trace of disbelief flashed in her eyes.
The ice and snow she activates is not ordinary ice source power, but the cold power that contains the magic of the Winter Kingdom. Ordinary flames cannot be melted at all, and only epic-level flames can compete with it.
"I really can't tell, you have so many tricks up your sleeve."
Aisha's tone was a little colder, and the fear in her eyes deepened.
"In that case..."
Elsa took out another card and shouted in a deep voice: "Magic card, blizzard."
As the card's light surged, a storm that was more violent and faster than before swept across instantly.
